calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, o.login_state, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_distinct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') AS utc_date_count,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') AS helsinki_count,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date=DATE '2025-12-01') AS orders_with_lines_sale_date,
 (SELECT MIN(order_ts_utc)||' / '||MAX(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') AS ts_range
